Players Committee card image of [[Krennic, Death Star Commandant]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, if Death Star orbiting a battleground, may peek at top two cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand. Once per game, may take a non-unique Star Destroyer into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/krennicdeathstarcommandant.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
